no_api_findings.finding: The versioned standard-library package inventory has no PLY/Stanford mesh decoder. io.Reader and os.Open provide bytes but do not interpret PLY headers or vertices. image.Decode dispatches to registered image decoders, not a bundled PLY parser. No documented format-aware standard API was available to run against the control.

limit: This covers documented Go 1.27.1 standard-library APIs; third-party bindings and installed native libraries are separate.
